description: Our imported structural steel frame is for a Part 4 industrial building. The connection package is explicitly designed to Eurocode 3 only, with no conformity demonstration to the Canadian structural steel design standard. The client wants to submit the unchanged overseas package as the alternative basis.

gold.departure: Part 4 structural steel design uses a different standard instead of demonstrating conformity with CSA S16.
